header: The page's extended plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, at most 5 minutes with every timeout counted,
for when a longer play than the regular one (tools/play_plan.json) is needed: the launcher, Load ROM on a new profile
once the shader list Chrome builds behind it is done (Firefox builds none there and says so), Start Game, the attract
race, which plays by itself, about 15 s, then through the menus as a player (keys held 150 ms: A Space, B Left Shift,
Start Enter) to three races in one load, each left by the pause menu's QUIT and YES: PRACTICE on track 1 and track 3
and STUNT's first arena, about 25 s each. The menus go by the game's own state (0x801174B4, a bit a screen: 0x10 the
main menu, 0x40 SELECT MODE, 0x80 SELECT TRACK, 0x100 the car select, 0x400000 a race), SELECT MODE's cursor
(0x803B469F) and the pause menu's (0x80149D9B); each race's start is a need that the game is racing on the track asked
for (0x8014978C: 0 and 2 the first and third tracks, 14 the first stunt arena). PRACTICE has no time limit, so a race
driven blind plays on. Each is driven with the gas held and a light weave, its waits and holds on the race clock
(0x801543CC, seconds, stopped while paused), with a shot about 8 s in.
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|once the game draws
play: new Promise((ok) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const t = setInterval(() => { let y = false; try { y = (n64r(0x801174B4) & 0x8) != 0; } catch (e) {} if (y) { clearInterval(t); ok(true); } else if (Date.now() - t0 > 12000) { clearInterval(t); let w = ''; try { w = 'state ' + n64r(0x801174B4).toString(16) + ' track ' + (n64r(0x8014978C) >>> 24) + ' mode ' + (n64r(0x803B469C) & 255) + ' clock ' + (Math.floor(new Float32Array(new Uint32Array([n64r(0x801543CC)]).buffer)[0] * 60) / 60).toFixed(1); } catch (e) { w = String(e); } console.log('[plan] attract timed out: ' + w); ok(false); } }, 100); })
